items.hook: John Galliano exhibition at New York Met cancelled after backlash
items.body: The exhibition faced criticism over the British fashion designer's conviction for making antisemitic remarks in 2011.

items.hook: Semi-pro football club 'in shock' after shirt worn by Reading Festival headliners
items.body: The club says sales of the shirt almost doubled after it was worn by Fontaines D.C frontman Grian Chatten.

items.hook: GWR FM was a network of three radio stations in the south west of England broadcasting to Bristol, Bath, Wiltshire and surrounding areas.
items.body: All three stations were rebranded and joined the Heart Network on 23 March 2009. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: I Drink for a Reason is a 2009 book by American actor and comedian David Cross.
items.body: The book features memoirs, satirical fictional memoirs and material from Cross that originally appeared in other publications. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Anthony Torrone is an American Christian author who has a developmental disability.
items.body: Torrone's 2011 book Anthony's Prayers was inspired by his time at, and the abuse that he experienced as a resident of, the former Willowbrook State School, a New York State mental hospital for children. The world is stranger than it lets on.
